summary: Iteration 6 - Frontend-only regression of upload & delete workflow (Customer Panel). Executed all 11 requested scenarios via Playwright against the public preview URL. All flows behave as specified: upload confirm/cancel, required->uploaded transition, two-step delete (confirm + mandatory reason), empty-reason validation, deletionLog persistence, required doc auto-restore on delete, cross-OLI isolation, refresh persistence, 5MB validation, MyDocuments delete uses same modal, internal-only reason secrecy (not rendered anywhere in portal), and search/clear regression on My Documents. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: modals.jsx DeleteDocModal: fine as-is. state mutation via structuredClone works. Consider disabling submit button while empty for stronger UX, but empty-reason error path is functional.
commitUpload correctly stores reqDoc linkage; deletion inversely restores requiredDocs[*].uploaded=false when reqDoc is present.
store.jsx: deletionLog seeded and migration in place (parsed.deletionLog || []). LocalStorage debounce (250ms) is fine; consider clearing timeout on unmount only (already handled).
seed_data_creation: None - relied on fresh localStorage seed
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 12 tests passed (test1 upload cancel, test2 required->uploaded transition, test3 delete cancel + confirm, test4 empty reason error, test5 internal-only reason secrecy verified on service page/MyDocuments/dashboard, test6 required-doc auto-restore after delete, test7 cross-OLI isolation with TM 'All required documents have been uploaded.', test8 refresh persistence for upload/delete/deletionLog, test9 5MB reject, MyDocuments two-step delete, and search regression). Note when writing selectors: seeded doc PAN.pdf can collide with uploaded 'pan.pdf' string-inclusion match; use exact filename equality when searching for dynamically uploaded docs.
rca of the issue: N/A - no issues found. Initial test-run appeared to fail two assertions (test5 internal / test6 required reappear) but RCA showed my test finder used substring match ('pan.pdf' in 'PAN.pdf'.lower() -> True) matching the SEEDED PAN.pdf (no reqDoc linkage) instead of the newly uploaded pan.pdf. Re-run with exact filename equality confirmed app is correct.
